optimizedDescription.value: Lifecycle-managed CodeGraphProvider composes stores, adapters, indexing, normalized resolution, impact, search, and public API.

optimizedContext.value:
# Composition
## Rules
- `CodeGraphProvider` lifecycle facade: `index({force:true})` clears logical state and reprocesses inputs, never recreates physical storage; `clear()` resets open reusable store; `recreate()` only while closed, rejects open call with typed precondition, succeeds closed; parameterless `open()` surfaces typed corruption/schema recovery error without implicit recreation; idempotent `close()` settles/rejects outstanding work before worker/DB shutdown.
- Queries, exact batches, FTS, traversal, impact, selector normalization delegate to store/services. `getSpec` missing => `undefined`. Each composite operation performs exactly one availability/staleness validation before bounded fan-out. Public callers use SDK forced-reindex recovery, not routine recreation. Worker/lock helpers internal.
- Symbol/file/multi-file/spec/public-binding impact accepts shared typed filter, returns deterministic prefiltered `ImpactResult` with `affectedSpecs` for every target family. Symbol/public-binding `specs` use coverage. Pass normalized predicates through traversal, store, SQLite worker, physical query; never post-project unrestricted results. Export host filter/result/request types; query plans, predicate builders, worker DTOs, backend candidates internal.
- Factories: `createCodeGraphProvider(config: SpecdConfig, options?: CodeGraphCompositionOptions)` derives root from `config.configPath`; legacy `createCodeGraphProvider(options: CodeGraphOptions)` requires `storagePath`. Detect by project-root-bearing `SpecdConfig`. Select `graphStoreId ?? "sqlite"`; merge sole built-in `sqlite` with additive `graphStoreFactories`; reject `sqlite` collision and unknown id; create exactly one store. Register TypeScript/Python/Go/PHP plus additive `adapters`; wire `IndexCodeGraph`. External factories share lifecycle/root contract.
- `createSqliteGraphStoreFactory()` accepts `SqliteGraphStoreFactoryOptions` and optional serializable `SqliteRuntimeDescriptor`; factory/provider creation synchronous. Native load, worker start, schema prep, binding resolution, generation checks occur during `open()`. Absolute `modulePath` becomes `file:` URL before import.
- `CodeGraphProvider` public type only; concrete class/constructor, `GraphStore`, worker protocol, `IndexCodeGraph` inputs internal. Construction only through factory.
- Public `.` exports curated composition, isolated indexing host contracts, host use cases, graph config, public index/discovery types, traversal/impact/hotspot/search/fingerprint helpers and types, `LanguageAdapter`, graph model/reference/search vocabulary, public typed errors, `CODE_GRAPH_VERSION`. No raw locks/IPC/bootstrap/launchers/child implementation/concrete stores/test helpers/star leaks/Ladybug symbols. Host isolated-worker contracts remain public.
- `src/public.ts` maps `.`; `src/index.ts` maps `./internal` for development internals including adapters, raw locks, launchers, `InMemoryIndexSession`. Publish ESM isolated-worker child under `dist/`, resolved internally relative to installed module; no host-selectable export.
- Explicit lifecycle: callers `open()` before query/traversal/index unless helper manages it. Backends may defer readiness to `open()`. Long-lived hosts create synchronously, await open, reuse without sync SQLite on host event loop, close explicitly. No auto-open/close.
- Runtime dependency `@specd/core` for `SpecdConfig`, `SpecdWorkspaceConfig`, optional services. Config only derives composition inputs; provider stores no project config. Caller supplies workspace targets/spec sources per `index()`.
- Host use cases receive open provider: `GetGraphHealth`/`createGetGraphHealth`, `IndexProjectGraph`/`createIndexProjectGraph`, `GetSpecCoverage`/`createGetSpecCoverage`, `GetChangeSpecCoverage`/`createGetChangeSpecCoverage`. Search/hotspots/impact/traversal stay provider methods.
- Symbol-reference surface supports single/batch resolution, canonical/public-binding impact, exact public-binding lookup by surface + exported name + symbol space + canonical target. Exact lookup returns binding/declarations without ranked pagination. Outcomes unique/ambiguous/missing. Unqualified selectors: case-exact then case-insensitive exact only; no prefix/text widening; bound candidates. Invalid host selector uses typed `INVALID_GRAPH_SELECTOR`. Ambiguity enrichment uses exactly one exact batch lookup. Export contracts/vocabulary/factories; implementations/storage internal.
- Factory passes same indexing `AdapterRegistry` into provider resolution; never second registry or hardcoded language dispatch. Unanchored `Tipo.miembro`/`Tipo::miembro` resolves by stored `qualified_name` equality without adapter. Other normalization selects adapter only from explicit language, anchored indexed file, or indexed public-surface metadata; absent anchor => unresolved. Provider never parses manifests/member syntax itself.
- Unified search accepts query, `symbols | files | specs | documents`, shared filters, per-category limit, snippet preference. Normalize exact file filters (workspace-relative, config/project-relative, absolute) to one graph file; preserve wildcards. Shared use case builds plan, runs semantic/backend lanes, locates occurrences, suppresses only symbol-selection-covered ranges, groups/ranks, caps general/wildcard occurrences per file, applies limits after grouping. Exact single-file returns all retained occurrences. Delivery adapters cannot reimplement expansion, independent merge, dedupe, or limits. Lower-level search may remain; unified operation authoritative.
## Constraints
- Only construction path `createCodeGraphProvider`; `CodeGraphProvider` type-only.
- Internals/store adapters only from `"./internal"`; `LanguageAdapter` from `"."`.
- Registry-driven backend selection, not `specd.yaml`; exactly one active store; built-in/default only `sqlite`.
- Facade owns lifecycle/availability/locks/recovery, not domain logic.
- Explicit lifecycle; no auto-open/close or implicit recreation.
- Provider locks/recreation helpers internal.
- Depends on `@specd/core` for `SpecdConfig`.
